jobs.title: Head of Medical Coding, Germany
jobs.description: At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients. We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning. The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it! The role As Head of Medical Coding, Germany, you will be our German coding authority and the first coding expert on our founding German team. You will teach our AI engineers how German DRG coding really works, settle the hard cases, and make sure every suggestion we make holds up in an MD audit. You are the German equivalent of the DIM physician who helped us build Parallel in France. Parallel uses AI to take administrative work off hospital teams, starting with inpatient coding. Our agents read the full patient record before billing, find what was documented but not coded, and coders validate every suggestion. We work with around 100 hospitals and clinics in France and are launching in Germany in 2027. Reports to: Paul Lafforgue, CEO and co-founder, until the GM Germany joins. You work closely with Dr. Quentin Jarrion, our physician coding lead in France. Location: Berlin or Munich, hybrid. Travel up to 40% (pilot hospitals, DGfM events), plus 2 to 4 weeks of onboarding in Paris. Team: you will recruit and

Candidates can work remotely in Hungary, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, UK or Spain. Precision for Medicine is a precision medicine CRO. Precision’s uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical experts, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology, in addition to working across other therapeutic areas. You will be the hub of central intelligence for the studies you will be managing and will lead CRAs and oversee all clinical aspects of your study across multiple countries, ensuring timeline adherence and scope, whilst ensuring quality delivery. We encourage high-energy, dedicated professionals who enjoy a challenge, thrive in the details and flourish in dynamic environments to explore this opportunity. We are addressing the challenges facing the research and development of novel compounds in Oncology and are dedicated to positively impacting the health and lives of patients around the world. If you take a consultative approach to trial management, proving to be a valuable partner in the trial operational delivery process, don't miss exploring working with us. jobs.description: Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. At Precision for Medicine we have brought together new technologies, expertise and operational scale to help the life sciences improve the speed, cost and success rate of bringing life-changing therapies to patients. What sets us apart is the way we integrate clinical trial execution with deep scientific knowledge, laboratory expertise and advanced data sciences. We have a strong focus on Oncology and Rare Disease. Precision for Medicine is looking for Senior/Clinical Research Associate. Position Summary: The Senior/CRA has wide-ranging and broad experience and typically handles the most complex and advanced assignments. Responsibilities will be dependent upon the type and timing of the program to which the Senior CRA is assigned and will, at a minimum, include start-up and study implementation activities, on-site monitoring of clinical research studies as well as on-going site management. Incumbents are expected to be able to manage appropriately sized or complex clinical trials, and support Clinical Trial Managers and/or Project Managers with trials as required. An increased focus on training and mentoring junior staff members may be expected. jobs.description: About Lantern Lantern is the specialty care platform connecting people with the best care when they need it most. By curating a Network of Excellence comprised of the nation's top specialists for surgery, cancer care, infusions and more, Lantern delivers excellent care with significant cost savings to employers and their workforces. Lantern also pairs members with a dedicated care team, including Care Advocates and nurses, for the entirety of their care journey, helping them get back to good health, back to their families and back to work. With convenient access to specialists nationwide, Lantern means quality care is within driving distance for most. Lantern is trusted by the nation's largest employers to deliver care to more than 6 million members across the country. Learn more about us at lanterncare.com. Director, Solutions Architect (Health Plans) *This is an individual contributor role* Lantern is looking for a Director, Solutions Architect to join our fast-growing team. This is an individual contributor Solutions Consultant-like role serving as a trusted advisor and solutions leader, partnering with Health Plan Sales leadership to drive and win new business. The individual will leverage deep health plan and vendor expertise to design creative, scalable solutions and integration strategies, particularly in risk products, that align with partner goals and operational priorities. Acting as the bridge between business challenges and technical/product solutions, this role will collaborate cross-functionally to shape infrastructure for growth, manage new initiative intake, resolve escalations, and inform go to market and implementation strategy. Success requires balancing detailed technical and financial conversations along with strategic, executive-level discussions, fostering strong stakeholder relationships, and championing innovative approaches that maintain long-term business growth. jobs.title: Senior Clinical Trials Systems Manager
jobs.description: Â POSITION SUMMARY: Job Function: Clinical Operations Title: Senior Clinical Trial Systems Lead The Senior Clinical Trials Systems Lead serves as the business owner representative for Clinical Operations systems, such as CTMS and eTMF. This role defines business problems and intended use, facilitates the prioritization for system updates and enhancements, coordinates handoff to IT and product partners, reviews designs and prototypes iteratively, and coordinates user acceptance testing and go-live approval. This individual will work in partnership with IS&T, Product, UI/UX, QA, Training, and the vendors who design, build, and validate outsourced systems. The role is also the day-to-day business point of contact for users and cross-functional teams, supporting troubleshooting, and continuous system improvements. The Senior Clinical Trials Systems Lead helps ensure that systems meet the requirements of study protocols, regulatory standards, business objectives, and user needs, and are fit for their intended use. Â PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: Partner directly with clinical science, quality, and regulatory teams to plan, test, and deploy new clinical systems and enhancements. Support system compliance with FDA, EMA, and ICH-GCP standards by defining GxP impact for all changes. Work closely with IS&T, QA, and product teams to manage system integrations, upgrades, and vendor service levels. Document stakeholder requirements clearly, identify process gaps, and propose actionable solutions. Review system designs and prototypes iteratively, providing fast, direct feedback. Coordinate and execute user acceptance testing (UAT), documenting results to provide final business sign-off. Serve as the primary functional support contact for internal teams, troubleshooting issues and escalating technical blockers to IS&T.
